chunks: And from him, from Safwan and Fadalah, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
“The obligatory prayer is not valid inside the Kaaba.” And as for when one fears missing the prayer, there is no harm in praying it inside the Kaaba. Narrated.
ai.seo_question: Is the obligatory prayer valid inside the Kaaba?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the juristic distinction between the general invalidity of offering obligatory prayers within the Kaaba's interior and the exception for *khawf al-fawt* (fear of missing the prayer time). While the default ruling prohibits it to maintain the sanctity of the structure, the permissibility under duress highlights the principle of *al-maslahah al-muraddah* (contextual benefit) in Shia fiqh, ensuring the obligation is fulfilled even in constrained spaces.
